recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中漿細胞增加，B 圖一顆核偏位的漿細胞細胞質內塞滿許多針狀、棒狀的淡紫色結晶，形似 Auer rods，為輕鏈結晶沉積（crystal-storing）的漿細胞，配合蛋白尿提示輕鏈骨髓瘤。
features: Increased plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm (panel A), including a large binucleate/multinucleate form
Panel B: plasma cell with a round eccentric nucleus and abundant pale cytoplasm
Numerous needle-shaped to rod-like, lavender cytoplasmic crystalline inclusions resembling Auer rods
Crystals radiate beyond the main cytoplasmic mass in a haphazard array
Background of maturing myeloid cells and erythrocytes
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an increase in plasma cells, including atypical binucleate forms. Some plasma cells contain abundant cytoplasm filled with numerous slender, needle-like and rod-shaped crystalline inclusions resembling Auer rods. No myeloblasts with Auer rods are identified. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm with intracytoplasmic immunoglobulin light chain crystals; correlation with light chain restriction, serum free light chains and renal evaluation (e.g., light chain Fanconi syndrome) is recommended.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with Auer rods
ddx.vs: Auer rods occur in MPO-positive blasts with fine chromatin and high N:C ratio, not in plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and clock-face chromatin.
In crystal-storing histiocytosis the crystals lie within CD68-positive histiocytes rather than CD138-positive plasma cells.
Gaucher cells have fibrillary wrinkled tissue-paper cytoplasm and small central nuclei rather than discrete refractile needles.
Charcot-Leyden crystals are bipyramidal, extracellular or within eosinophils, and associated with eosinophil degranulation.
